items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I went to work over here with Essie at this other club

ctx.x: E-s-s-e. And he was an old-timer.

Now, he'd been around with guys, you know, when I heard him talk about so many older musicians I'd heard talk about, but I'd never met him, you know. But anyway, Lee Deere took his group up there and I went to work over here with Essie at this other club, see? And that was -- I really got a lot of experience right there, you know, and part of the experience that, you know, I got from just sitting there with Essie and then I'd go out and these guys, they would also get music, you know, because Lee Deere, he…
that not too long ago, he owned the Thunderbird in Vegas.
